plan.objective: Test whether phone-based leaf-disease screening can run at a small group of farms in this synthetic challenge.
plan.scope: Proposed field screening at a small number of farms, using agreed crop images and an agreed evaluation method.

milestones.action: Discovery meeting to confirm the problem and the buyer requirements
Data-access and consent confirmation for crop images
Field screening run at agreed farms, with weekly review notes
Joint review of results against the proposed success criteria

success_criteria.metric: Screening agreement with expert review on a sampled set of images
success_criteria.target: Proposed target to be agreed before the run
success_criteria.validation_method: Expert re-check of a sampled subset, agreed in advance

preconditions: A named field contact at the partner
ip_questions: Who owns any improvements made to the model during the pilot?
data_sharing_questions: Which crop images may be used and stored, and for how long?
liability_questions: Who is responsible if a screening result leads to a wrong crop treatment?
plan.possible_conversion_to_paid: Hypothesis only: a paid pilot could follow if the agreed criteria are met. This is not a promise.
roles_and_responsibilities: Startup: provide the detection tool and a field workflow guide (proposed)
Partner: nominate farms and a field contact (proposed)
budget_questions: Is there a pilot budget, and who pays for field time?
local_regulatory_checks: Confirm with a qualified adviser whether agricultural or data rules apply in Indonesia.
assumptions: Partner farms are willing to participate
plan.next_action: Hold the discovery meeting. No pilot work starts before the consent check.

notice: Includes synthetic demo records. Scores are rule-based compatibility only, not funding or success probability.
